description: KBR is a scientific, technology, and engineering solutions provider, serving governments and commercial customers around the world. Founded in 1901, the company has two segments: government solutions and sustainable technology solutions. KBR’s services include research and development, cyber analytics, space domain awareness, and more. The company also provides synergistic services, such as net-zero carbon emission solutions, and operates a portfolio of proprietary process technologies.

rankings.itemDescription: KBR, formerly known as Kellogg, Brown & Root, has a long history as a top contractor in defense and aerospace, with roots dating back to World War II. The company offered engineering, procurement, and construction services for clients including the U.S. military until 2020, when it pivoted. Under new CEO Stuart J.B. Bradie, the company has shifted its focus to technology services. Among KBR's new clients is the U.S. Geological Survey, with which it has a contract to analyze satellite data.
